sql: select now() as now_utc, o.market_ticker, o.side, o.limit_price px, o.quantity q, o.created_at, s.at snap_at, left(s.yes_levels_json::text,110) yes_lv, left(s.no_levels_json::text,110) no_lv, round(s.est_yes_score_total::numeric,1) yt, round(s.est_no_score_total::numeric,1) nt, s.est_yes_meets_target ym, s.est_no_meets_target nm, p.period_reward_usd pool, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.target_size from live_orders o left join lateral (select * from incentive_market_snapshots x where x.market_ticker=o.market_ticker order by at desc limit 1) s on true left join lateral (select * from incentive_programs ip where ip.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and ip.end_date > now() and ip.incentive_type='liquidity' order by ip.end_date desc limit 1) p on true where o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted') order by o.created_at
